name: HomeRepairs

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: Several repairs are needed but not all are equally urgent

scenario_template.topic: Listing current and potential home repairs
scenario_template.note: They discuss plumbing, appliances, painting, and maintenance

scenario_template.topic: Realizing they cannot afford every repair immediately
scenario_template.note: They need to distinguish urgent issues from cosmetic improvements

scenario_template.topic: Prioritizing repairs within the household budget
scenario_template.note: They ask how to organize immediate and future costs

scenario_template.topic: Creating separate repair and maintenance savings categories
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps distinguish predictable maintenance from emergencies

scenario_template.topic: Deciding which projects to postpone
scenario_template.note: They compare safety, necessity, cost, and appearance

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting the plan after receiving a larger repair estimate
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them reconsider priorities

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a repair priority list and savings plan
scenario_template.note: They have a clearer plan for the property

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
